title: ProviderSwitch
responsibility: Wraps provider-switch records in switches and delegates queries and mutations to a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.session
inputs.description: Session key identifying the provider-switch record.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.id
inputs.description: Recorded switch ID, separate from the session primary key.

inputs.name: ProviderSwitch.data
inputs.description: Structured payload retained by the adapter; no model code is executed to describe it.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.find
outputs.description: Promise of the matching switches row, or null according to the adapter lookup result.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.findBy
outputs.description: Promise of switches rows matching the supplied attribute filters.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.create
outputs.description: Promise of the switches row returned by the adapter after creation.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.update
outputs.description: Promise of the updated switches row, or null according to the adapter update result.

outputs.name: ProviderSwitch.delete
outputs.description: Promise of the adapter deletion result for the requested switches row.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Adapter exceptions and promise rejections pass through unchanged; caller-provided field getters can also throw during argument copying.
